backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor managing Stripe config, user profiles and plans, invoice records, event logging, and anonymous usage tracking with reset logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping Spain VAT‑related features to affected files, components, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purposes of numerous frontend React components, pages, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_SLUG.md: Documentation defining the app’s deployment slug rules, constraints, and validation performed in appMeta.ts.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base configuration defining light and dark theme variables and global style resets.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting app title and including root element plus module script for main.tsx.
frontend/PRODUCTION_PUBLISH_V4.md: Version 5 production publish checklist covering build steps, deployment, verification, Stripe checks, and rollback steps.
frontend/PRODUCTION_SMOKE_CHECK.md: Smoke‑test runbook for validating production behavior such as console marker, routing, auth, and Stripe checkout flow.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the root React router, defines all routes, wraps the app in a theme provider, and renders a toaster.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity, handling auth state, errors, and query cache resets.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceD: Renders a detailed invoice entry form with validation, VAT logic, auto-legal text, and navigation callbacks.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceM: Displays mandatory invoice fields with pass/fail indicators and an alert summarizing missing fields.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceP: Generates invoice HTML, runs risk checks, and manages saving, printing, and PDF downloading with plan and quota checks.
frontend/src/components/invoice/InvoiceR: Shows a modal summarizing invoice risk analysis, listing critical issues and warnings with disclaimers.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with header navigation, footer, routing outlet, and event logging on app load.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeA: Allows admins to configure Stripe by submitting a secret key, showing setup UI only when needed and secured by permissions.
frontend/src/components/payments/StripeC: Renders a Stripe checkout button that creates a checkout session, logs events, and redirects to Stripe. Handles loading state and errors.
frontend/src/components/usage/LimitReach: Shows a modal when the user hits usage limits, logs an upgrade CTA event, and links to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UpgradeMod: Displays a modal comparing Starter and Pro plans, logs a CTA event, and navigates users to the upgrade page.
frontend/src/components/usage/UsageLimit: Shows remaining monthly invoice quota for Free plan users based on account plan data.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountrySelec: Empty file placeholder for a VAT flow step.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryTrans: Handles VAT transaction inputs including customer type, service category, VAT treatment, and rate selection with dynamic logic. Includes reverse charge handling and country‑specific VAT rules.
frontend/src/components/vat/CountryVatDe: Displays VAT details for a selected country, including rates, features, and configuration state, with navigation controls.
frontend/src/components/vat/EuVatIntroSt: Presents a list of EU countries for VAT calculation and continues once a selection is made.
frontend/src/components/vat/ExplainVatPa: Shows standard and simplified VAT explanations and gates PDF export behind a Pro paywall.
Modal prompting users to upgrade to Pro for VAT explanations, logging CTA events and linking to the upgrade page.
Renders a horizontal step indicator showing progress through a multistep VAT flow, highlighting current and completed steps.
frontend/src/components/vat/GlobalDiscla: Displays an informational alert warning that VAT values are estimates and not legal or tax advice.
frontend/src/components/vat/ReverseCharg: Validates a VAT ID for reverse‑charge eligibility and shows pass/fail indicators for format, country match, and final allowance.
frontend/src/components/vat/TransactionD: Collects VAT‑calc input like customer type, VAT ID, amounts, and rate selection, with optional reverse‑charge validation for B2B.
frontend/src/components/vat/VatResultsSt: Shows computed net, VAT, and total amounts, plus scenario‑specific alerts for reverse charge, exemptions, or special rules.
frontend/src/config/appMeta.ts: Defines app metadata and validates a deployment slug against allowed formatting constraints during build.
frontend/src/hooks/useAccountPlan.ts: Fetches the user's active subscription plan and monthly invoice usage by querying the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAnonymousUsage.ts: Tracks anonymous user daily usage via fingerprinting, enforces a free‑tier limit, and increments usage on demand.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Creates a Stripe checkout session through the backend and validates the returned session URL.
frontend/src/hooks/useDailyFingerprint.t: Computes a daily fingerprint and country from IP, exposing availability and loading state for usage tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useEventLogger.ts: Provides a log function that sends analytics events with fingerprint and country metadata via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication via AuthClient, including login state and stored identities.
Defines React Query hooks for invoice-related operations such as listing, downloading PDFs or ZIPs, and exporting CSV/Excel via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInvoiceQuota.ts: Implements invoice save mutation with plan-based quota checks and invalidates related queries after saving.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlanAccess.ts: Exposes convenience booleans for plan type (free, starter, pro) based on account plan data.
Determines the browser’s preferred language and exposes it with a simple English check.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Adds queries for fetching the current user profile and checking Stripe configuration using the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS base setup with light/dark theme variables and utility classes for dropdown and layout behavior.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/coreEvents.ts: Defines canonical analytics event name constants and their type.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/countryDetect: Performs best-effort country detection using ipapi.co and returns country code and IP.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/eventLogger.t: Builds and sends event records to the backend actor, auto‑filling metadata like device, page, and timestamp.
frontend/src/lib/analytics/fingerprint.t: Computes and caches a daily SHA‑256 fingerprint based on IP, user agent, and date.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/buildInvoiceHtm: Generates complete invoice HTML by combining VAT results, translations, formatting helpers, and legal text.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/getAutoLegalVat: Returns predefined legal VAT text based on the VAT scenario.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/riskCheck.ts: Runs invoice risk checks by validating mandatory fields, legal VAT text, reverse charge proof, VAT‑exempt rules, and date logic to produce risks, warnings, and pass/fail status.
frontend/src/lib/invoice/validateInvoice: Validates required invoice fields based on scenario and returns missing fields and pass/fail status.
frontend/src/lib/production/productionMa: Logs a production‑only console marker and exposes the marker string for testing.
frontend/src/lib/translation/deToEn.ts: Provides deterministic German‑to‑English word-by-word translation and a heuristic to detect German text.
frontend/src/lib/vat/calculateVat.ts: Defines VAT input/result types and computes VAT scenarios including reverse charge, exemptions, reduced rates, and legacy Germany rules.
frontend/src/lib/vat/euCountryConfig.ts: Stores VAT configuration for EU countries and exposes helpers to retrieve country settings.
frontend/src/lib/vat/explainVat.ts: Generates detailed textual VAT explanations for each scenario, including exemptions, reverse charge, and OSS rules.
Provides simplified, kid-friendly explanations of VAT scenarios.
frontend/src/lib/vat/germanyVatRateHisto: Defines historical German VAT rates and helper functions to get current/dated rates and detect historical differences.
frontend/src/lib/vat/index.ts: Re-exports key VAT modules for easier imports.
frontend/src/lib/vat/ossIndicator.ts: Determines whether a transaction is OSS-relevant based on service type, customer type, and EU cross-border rules.
frontend/src/lib/vat/promptFlowGermany.t: Holds system prompts and screen prompts for the Germany-specific VAT calculation flow.
frontend/src/lib/vat/validateReverseChar: Validates VAT ID format and country match to determine reverse‑charge eligibility for B2B transactions.
frontend/src/lib/vat/vatCategoryRateRule: Defines VAT categories and computes reduced rates for several EU countries based on category and rules.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Sets up React app root with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/CalculatorFlowPage.ts: Implements multi‑step VAT calculator flow handling user input, VAT calculation, navigation, and invoice preview.
frontend/src/pages/InvoicesPage.tsx: Displays invoice list with selection, downloads, exports, and upgrade gating based on user plan.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page showcasing features, supported countries, and navigation to the VAT calculator.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailurePage.ts: Displays a payment failure message with options to retry upgrading or return home.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccessPage.ts: Shows a payment success confirmation, logs the event, refreshes plan data, and offers navigation to calculator or invoices.
frontend/src/pages/UpgradePage.tsx: Renders plan options and handles authentication, Stripe readiness, and checkout session creation for upgrades.
frontend/src/utils/downloadFile.ts: Utility to create a Blob from text or binary data and trigger a file download in the browser.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read, persist, and clear URL parameters using query strings, hash routing, and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending colors, animations, shadows, and container settings with plugins enabled.
project_state.json: Tracks project metadata, existing features, pending requests, and versioning for Spain VAT configuration work.
